issues.detail: The Hebrew names זֶבַח (Zebah) and צַלְמֻנָּע (Zalmunna) are transliterated in Chinese as 祭物 and 撒勒穆拿 respectively. 祭物 means 'sacrifice/offering' in Chinese, which is a semantic translation of the name Zebah (which means 'sacrifice'), not a transliteration. This could mislead a Chinese reader into thinking the text refers to a sacrificial offering rather than a personal name. The name should be transliterated (e.g., 西巴) to preserve the proper name.
